title: Garden and Mud — Two Orientations
kind: ethical-symbolic orientation model with quantitative systems bridge
purpose: Formalize a recurring Tim Dooley / Potato of Life contrast that cuts across theology, ethics, psychology, politics and storytelling: Garden versus Mud as orientations rather than fixed classes of people, while routing the newer Mud/Swamp/Debt/Mountain state model and the quantitative Garden/Farm control model into the broader transformation architecture.
epistemic_rule: Garden and Mud are symbolic and ethical orientations in the Potatoverse. They should not be used to dehumanize people or to convert disagreement into proof that someone belongs to an inferior category. Quantitative Garden/Farm metrics apply to declared systems and outcomes, not human worth or spiritual rank.

garden.orientation: toward cultivation, connection and living order
garden.question: What conditions allow life, truth and relationship to grow here?
garden.dependency_test: A mature Garden increases the independent capability of what grows within it. If a center must keep everyone permanently dependent, orbiting, reactive or harvestable in order to remain important, the structure is becoming Farm-like rather than Garden-like.

mud.orientation: toward stuckness, fragmentation and repeated conflict when residue remains unprocessed
mud.question: What keeps the system circling injury without converting it into learning or growth?
mud.process_definition: Mud is best treated as residue/trace rather than a complete environment. Individual accusations, humiliations, injuries, memories, screenshots, corrections, legal records and other durable traces can become Mud-like material depending on context and evidence status.

critical_distinction: Mud is also substrate. Potatoism does not teach that mud must simply be destroyed. A potato grows in soil; roots descend into difficult material. The deeper model is therefore not Garden good / Mud evil, but Mud -> contextualization/decomposition -> Soil -> Root -> Potato -> Sprout -> Tree -> Fruit. The ethical failure is not contact with mud; it is remaining trapped in sterile conflict when transformation is possible.

state_relations.Swamp: an environment formed when unresolved residue accumulates, overlaps and begins shaping later behavior
state_relations.Debt: a relationship-specific unresolved obligation attributed to past action or failed duty; temporally, it is a past relation that still constrains future action
state_relations.Mountain: many weighted memories, obligations and paths compressed into a more integrated structure from which perspective and judgment become possible
state_relations.Door: the transition at which a repeating relation can change regime through truth, choice, repair, release or demonstrated non-liability
state_relations.Garden: the post-repair condition in which restored relations support autonomous future growth

memory_bifurcation.unresolved: past material that keeps returning without contextualization tends toward Swamp/recurrence
memory_bifurcation.integrated: past material that is sourced, distinguished and metabolized can become Soil/Root and support Mountain-level perspective
memory_bifurcation.principle: The goal is not forgetting. The goal is changing what memory does.

two_repair_routes.early: Mud -> provenance/context -> correction/repair -> Soil -> Root -> growth
two_repair_routes.late: Mud accumulation -> Swamp + unresolved obligation -> Debt -> integration/Mountain -> perspective -> Door -> repair/release -> Garden
two_repair_routes.principle: Resolve residue before it becomes structure. The project should not glorify maximal accumulation when earlier repair is possible.

repair_model.definition: Repair changes the state, weight or direction of a relationship rather than erasing the historical event.
repair_model.strong_repair: truth preserved + harmful mechanism stopped + relevant correction/restitution/change + restored agency + ability to leave the conflict
repair_model.why_this_matters: A system that can remember but cannot release becomes another archive of permanent debt. A system that releases by deleting truth becomes amnesia rather than repair.

movement.door_function: The Door marks the point where repetition can become transformation and where an open entanglement can change state.
movement.spiral_function: The spiral represents revisiting the same problem at a different level of understanding rather than merely repeating the same circle.
movement.mountain_function: Mountain integrates many differentiated traces toward perspective; it should not be confused with the Swamp that mixes them without stable footing.
movement.descent_after_summit: Perspective is incomplete until it returns to the Plane/Garden as service, repair, protection or cultivation.

scientific_control_bridge.central_result: Garden and Farm can share the same network topology while differing in objective function, reinvestment, exit freedom, knowledge transfer and dependence. The distinction is therefore not reducible to who is central or how many edges exist.
scientific_control_bridge.autonomy_test: A_i(c,tau)=performance after center c is removed for horizon tau / performance with ordinary support
scientific_control_bridge.viability: A Garden policy should keep states inside a declared viability region while increasing future capability and option value; maximizing short-term yield alone is insufficient.
scientific_control_bridge.multiobjective_rule: Track capability growth, autonomy retention, resilience, useful connectivity, repair, extraction burden and harm as a vector/Pareto problem before choosing any weighted scalar.
scientific_control_bridge.strongest_empirical_question: After support, leadership or a central node is reduced, what durable capability remains in the periphery?
scientific_control_bridge.archive_application: A Garden-like archive lets readers trace primary sources, reproduce derivations and disagree without dependence on Tim or assistant authority; usefulness should survive removal of the narrator.
scientific_control_bridge.boundary: These measurements compare system design and outcomes. They are not measures of divinity or personal moral worth.

applications: Personal conflict: ask whether an interaction produces learning, repair and boundaries or only repeated humiliation and retaliation.
Institutions: evaluate whether rules cultivate capability and protection or preserve dysfunctional repetition.
Politics: distinguish building resilient systems from maintaining identity through permanent enemies.
Archive design: preserve criticism and contradiction in forms that can improve the model rather than burying them; contextualized residue can become Soil instead of Swamp.
Theology: judgment should ideally orient toward transformation, not make condemnation the final state.
Karmic ledger: track specific unresolved edges and their repair state rather than converting all conflict into one irreversible global accusation.
Leadership: test whether a center produces stronger independent participants; if dependence itself is the product, the relation has drifted toward Farm/Shell rather than Garden/House.
Systems science: perturb or remove central support and measure capability retention, recovery time, viability and network function instead of inferring health from centrality alone.
